title: Tracecat 1.1.0-alpha.5
body_markdown:
## Breaking changes


- chore(integrations)!: Remove legacy Google SecOps Python actions ([#3583](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3583) )


## Case management


- fix(cases): Strip NUL bytes from case comment content ([#3594](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3594) )


## Tables


- feat(tables): Add semantic search column controls ([#3577](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3577) )
- feat(tables+actions): Add ranked semantic table search ([#3576](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3576) )
- feat(tables): Track semantic search indexing lifecycle ([#3572](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3572) )
- feat(tables): Reuse AI providers for search embeddings ([#3518](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3518) )


## Agents


- fix(agents): Preserve chunked HTTP request bodies ([#3610](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3610) )
- fix(agents+integrations): Surface and block custom actions shadowing builtins ([#3579](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3579) )
- feat(agents): Add pluggable session backends ([#3570](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3570) )
- feat(enterprise+skills): Add folders and tags for agent skills ([#3553](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3553) )
- fix(agents): Distinguish gateway cooldown from provider throttling ([#3538](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3538) )


## Integrations


- docs(integrations): Document the OAuth redirect URI ([#3590](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3590) )
- feat(integrations): Add Rapid7 templates and bulk export MCP server ([#3588](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3588) )
- feat(integrations): Add Perplexity MCP server ([#3587](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3587) )
- feat(integrations): Add Azure DevOps OAuth providers and HTTP templates ([#3581](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3581) )


## Engine


- fix(engine): Surface workload stderr in sandbox workload failures ([#3595](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3595) )
- feat(engine): Index table text in durable background batches ([#3575](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3575) )


## API


- fix(ui+api): Show real item counts on workflow folders ([#3571](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3571) )


## User interface


- fix(ui): Use official Google SecOps logo for Google Chronicle ([#3585](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3585) )
- fix(ui): Allow mouse wheel scrolling in folder picker dropdowns ([#3569](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3569) )


## Infrastructure


- fix(infra): Port alpha.2.1 migration re-parenting to main ([#3614](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3614) )
- ci: Enforce linear Alembic migrations ([#3613](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3613) )
- fix(infra): Merge alembic heads so upgrade head resolves ([#3612](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3612) )


## Documentation


- docs: Clarify alpha hotfix release branches ([#3611](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3611) )


**Full changelog** :[1.1.0-alpha.2.1...1.1.0-alpha.5](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/compare/1.1.0-alpha.2.1...1.1.0-alpha.5)
